lessonTitle: Acts Chapter 6 — The Choosing of the Seven / Stephen Seized

questions.questionText: How many disciples were increasing, and what problem came up?
options: The number grew and Grecian Jews complained their widows were being overlooked

questions.questionText: Who said it would not be right for them to neglect the ministry of the word of God in order to wait on tables?
How many men full of the Spirit and wisdom did they say to choose?
What would the Twelve give their attention to?
options: Prayer and the ministry of the word

questions.questionText: I am the first named of the seven, a man full of faith and of the Holy Spirit. Who am I?
I am one of the seven and later preach in Samaria. Who am I (second named)?
Where was Nicolas from?
What did the apostles do when they presented these men?
options: They prayed and laid their hands on them

questions.questionText: What happened to the word of God?
options: It spread and the number of disciples increased rapidly

questions.questionText: A large number of which group became obedient to the faith?
I was full of God’s grace and power and performed great wonders and signs. Who am I?
Who opposed Stephen?
options: Members of the Synagogue of the Freedmen

questions.questionText: Jews from which places were in that synagogue group?
True or false: They could not stand up against the wisdom the Spirit gave Stephen as he spoke.
What did they secretly persuade some men to say?
options: That they heard Stephen speak blasphemous words against Moses and against God

questions.questionText: Who did they stir up?
options: The people, the elders and the teachers of the law

questions.questionText: Where did they bring Stephen?
False witnesses said Stephen never stops speaking against what two things?
options: This holy place and the law

questions.questionText: They claimed Stephen said Jesus of Nazareth would do what?
options: Destroy this place and change the customs Moses handed down

questions.questionText: How did Stephen’s face look to the Sanhedrin?
options: Like the face of an angel

questions.questionText: I am one of the seven, from Antioch, a convert to Judaism. Who am I?
Besides Stephen and Philip, which of these was also chosen among the seven?
Who gathered all the disciples to solve the widow problem?
True or false: The whole group was pleased with the plan to choose seven men.
What kind of men were they to choose?
options: Known to be full of the Spirit and wisdom

questions.questionText: Where did the number of disciples increase rapidly?
People said I speak against Moses and God. Who am I?
Who seized Stephen?
options: The stirred-up people, elders and teachers of the law

questions.questionText: I produced false witnesses against Stephen. Who are we?
They said Stephen never stops speaking against this holy _____ and against the law.
They said I will destroy this place. Who did they name?
What customs did they say Jesus would change?
Stephen was brought before which council?
Who looked intently at Stephen and saw his face like an angel?
options: All who were sitting in the Sanhedrin

questions.questionText: I am full of faith and of the Holy Spirit and was chosen first among the seven. Who am I?
After choosing the seven, what spread?
True or false: Stephen performed great wonders and signs among the people.
options: False — he only waited on tables

questions.questionText: I am from Cyrene or Alexandria and argued with Stephen in the synagogue. Who are we?
options: Members of the Synagogue of the Freedmen

questions.questionText: The Twelve said they must not neglect the ministry of the _____ of God.
What work had been overlooking some widows?
